question: In Trans – Siberian railway system Vladivostok lies on ______ coast.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pacific.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Trans-Siberian railway **runs from **Vladivostok on the Pacific coast** to** St. Petersburg in western Russia.**
 
• The Trans-Siberian proper runs the** length and breadth of Russia**, connectin**g Moscow with Vladivostok and the Pacific Ocean via Perm, Yekaterinburg, Omsk, Novosibirsk, Irkutsk, Ulan Ude, Chita, and Khabarovsk.**
 
• The total length of the **Trans-Siberian railroad is 9258 kilometres**.
 
• It travels through** 30 cities in places** like** Siberia and the Russian** Far East, crossing** 7 time zones** in the process.
